g.text: 1. Split at blank lines, then at sentence ends;
hard-cut any piece still over 1,800 characters
2. Pack pieces into windows of ≤ 1,800 characters
3. Start each new window with the last ~150
characters of the one before (from a word start)
(this prefix is used for search only)
Rebuilding replaces the whole index; the stored text is the original, unprefixed text
